newsitem.title: USA: Hewlett-Packard to unveil new printers. [CORRECTED]
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard to unveil new printers. [CORRECTED]

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co. Monday will introduce a new photograph-quality DeskJet printer for the home market and two new LaserJet printers for the small business market, a company spokeswoman said.

The company's new LaserJet 6P and 6MP printers for small businesses can operate at eight pages a minute, 33 percent faster than their predecessors, and are expected to sell for less than $800 and $950 (corrects figure from $95), respectively.

The HP DeskJet 690C series printers are designed to enable individuals and families at home to print photograph images that it says are the closest ever in quality to traditional photographs, with prices starting at $329, H-P said.

For home users, the HP DeskJet 690C series printers features H-P's new Photographic Resolution Enhancement technology, dubbed "Photo-REt", which combines HP-developed technologies to deliver crisp, sharp prints.

The technology includes a newly designed colour-ink cartridge -- the HP Photo Cartridge -- which contains special photo inks with lighter shades of magenta and cyan, providing six colours of ink compared with four colours previously.
H-P expects the technology to help boost growth in the nascent PC photography market along with low-cost colour scanners, PhotoCD technology and digital cameras.
The DeskJet 609C series enables continuous-feed banner printing and two-sided printing. The printers can print up to five pages a minute for black and 1.7 per minute for colour.

A DeskJet 693C printer comes with the newest edition of the HP home project kit, which features Walt Disney Co.'s Disney Interactive 101 Dalmations Print Studeo CD-ROM and PrintPaks Family Fun Kit, for an expected price of $349.

H-P said its photo colour, including the HP photo printer cartridge, is expected to sell for $49 and the photo paper is expected to sell for $11.95 for 20 sheets for 8-1/2 inch by 11 inch paper. Banner and greeting card paper is also available.
The small business printer family produces high-quality 600 dots per inch output and a variety of paper-handling capabilities and the ability to add networking and memory.

Both models come with a graphical, task-based help system on CD-ROM, contain infrared technology for wireless printing, and enable Microsoft Windows 95 users to use a simple interface providing real-time status messages.

The LaserJet 6MP offers the same features as the 6P model, but provides compatability across the Apple Macintosh and Window Proscript environments and is designed to be attractive for desktop publishers and graphics professionals.
